talkNow.title: Talk to someone now
talkNow.desc: Urgent triage for a clinician available on demand.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.desc: Upcoming, past and missed appointments with join checklist.

payments.title: Payments
payments.desc: Consult fee, subscription, wallet and invoices.

crisisBanner.title: Messages are not for emergencies
crisisBanner.body: If you are in danger or need help right now, use crisis resources or Talk now.

patientTalkNow.title: Talk now
patientTalkNow.subtitle: Request an available clinician. Minimum fields only — finish your profile after if needed.

triage.title: Urgent triage
triage.intro: Confirm where you are, your phone, a short safety check, language and format.
triage.phoneConfirm: This number can receive a callback
triage.safetyQ1: Are you thinking about harming yourself right now?
triage.safetyQ2: Are you in immediate danger or unsafe where you are?
triage.safetyQ3: Is someone else in danger because of this situation?
triage.riskHint: You answered yes to a safety question. You can still request care — also open crisis resources.

waiting.title: Looking for a clinician
waiting.estimate: Typical wait under 15 minutes when coverage is available
waiting.breathTip: Breathe in for 4 counts, hold 4, out for 6. You can cancel or switch to a callback anytime.
waiting.riskNote: Because of your safety answers, keep crisis resources open while you wait.

unmatched.title: No clinician available right now
unmatched.body: Coverage can be limited. Choose a fallback so you are not left without options.
unmatched.callbackBody: We will call the number you confirmed when a clinician is free.
unmatched.slotBody: Browse verified clinicians and take the soonest available appointment.
unmatched.crisisBody: If you are unsafe or in immediate distress, use local emergency and crisis contacts.

patientSessions.title: Sessions
patientSessions.subtitle: Upcoming, past and missed visits — prepare with the join checklist.

checklist.title: Pre-session checklist
checklist.intro: Test your device, confirm a private place, and enable discreet mode if needed.
checklist.deviceTip: Check camera/mic or audio, and prefer Wi‑Fi. Low bandwidth? Switch to audio.
checklist.locationTip: You are somewhere quiet and private for the session length.
checklist.discreetTip: Hide session details on lock screen and use neutral notification wording.
checklist.joinDemo: Waiting room ready (demo). Live video room connects in a later release.

patientPayments.title: Payments
patientPayments.subtitle: Pay per consultation, manage subscription, wallet and invoices.

plans.consultBody: One scheduled or on-demand session with a verified clinician.
plans.subTitle: Monthly subscription
plans.subBody: Includes request allowance and daily urgent minutes meter.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.hint: Top up for consults and urgent holds. Card numbers are never stored by PeSSiLi.

patientSettings.title: Settings & privacy
patientSettings.subtitle: Language, discreet mode, emergency contact, devices and data controls.

language.title: Language preferences
language.body: Use the header language switch for Arabic, French or English. Session language can differ from the interface.

discreet.title: Discreet mode
discreet.hint: Neutral wording on lock screen; hide clinician names in banners.
discreet.on: Discreet mode is on for this device (demo).

appLock.title: App lock
appLock.body: PIN or biometric lock will protect re-opening the patient space on shared devices. Demo note only for now.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Export a copy of your account data or request deletion (subject to legal retention).
data.exportConfirm: Prepare a data export for this demo account?
data.deleteConfirm: Request account deletion? This is a demo confirmation only.

profileLink.prefix: For full identity and QR sign-in, open

patientGuardian.title: Guardian mode
patientGuardian.subtitle: Manage bookings and payments for dependents within consent limits.
patientGuardian.visibilityNote: By default you see schedule and invoices only. Clinical content appears only when consent allows.

patientScreening.title: Screening centre
patientScreening.body: Validated tools with automatic scoring. Screening is not a diagnosis.
patientScreening.likertHint: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

phq9.q1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
phq9.q3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
phq9.q4: Feeling tired or having little energy
phq9.q6: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
phq9.q7: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
phq9.q8: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed — or the opposite, being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
phq9.q9: Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way

gad7.q1: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
gad7.q2: Not being able to stop or control worrying
gad7.q3: Worrying too much about different things
gad7.q5: Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
gad7.q7: Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

guidance.minimal: Your answers suggest few symptoms right now. Re-screen if things change, or talk to a clinician if you still want support.
guidance.mild: Mild symptoms. Monitoring and self-care may help; a clinician can guide next steps.
guidance.moderate: Moderate symptoms. Consider booking a clinician or using Talk now.
guidance.moderatelySevere: Moderately severe symptoms. We recommend speaking with a clinician soon.
guidance.severe: Severe symptom range. Please seek clinical support — Talk now or book a session.

risk.title: Safety support first
risk.body: One of your answers suggests thoughts of self-harm. Please review crisis resources before viewing your score.

result.title: Your result
result.disclaimer: This is a screening result, not a medical diagnosis.
result.riskNote: You flagged a self-harm item. Keep crisis contacts available.

history.title: History & trends
history.empty: No saved results on this device yet. Complete a tool to see scores here.
history.hint: You will be able to share a result with your clinician and export a PDF.
